summary: Expose selected step labels on the caller's captured snapshot

replay.detail: No source replay or backfill. The existing indexed selected-label query is shared.

schema.detail: No tables, triggers, schema versions or view registrations.

rules.detail: Existing raw label semantics and parse errors are preserved; labels grant no source or authority certificate.

compatibility.detail: Public Store reader retains its batch behavior and fields. A new internal bounded accessor reuses an existing Connection.

manual.detail: Consumers can compose labels in their existing authorized snapshot, after separately verifying complete source and card dependencies.

recovery.detail: No derived state or recovery changes.
